title: SREV-003 UAC app name shape

shellexecute_field_shape.description: ShellExecuteW separates lpFile (file or object being executed) from lpParameters (parameters when lpFile is an executable); runas is the UAC/elevation shell verb

packet_field_shape.description: Sandboxie UAC packet carries three independent WCHAR arrays: app (identity or *MSI* token), cmd (full command line), dir (working directory or *MSI* token)

display_path_owner.description: RunUacSlave4(..., OutAppName) returns the app token only when app is exactly *MSI*; otherwise it preserves the previous command-line return

msi_token_shape.description: MSI token comparisons require exact five-WCHAR shape (*MSI* plus terminator) before treating the request as an MSI elevation token

execution_invariant.description: Execution behavior is unchanged; only the display/classification data shape is fixed

runtime_matrix.description: Windows runtime gate: MSI elevation prompt displays 'Windows Installer'; normal executable elevation still displays executable/command identity

contracts: ShellExecuteW lpFile and lpParameters are separate fields
CommandLineToArgvW parses a full Unicode command line into argv
PathFindFileNameW extracts a filename component from a path
RunUacSlave4 OutAppName must not return cmd when classifying *MSI* display text
*MSI* token belongs to app, not to the command-line return
MSI token check must prove exact five-WCHAR field length before comparing
Default UAC display for non-MSI requests remains the command-line classification
